New book chapter, with Nicola Cantore, Upalat Korwatanasakul, and Jaime Moll de Alba, analysing the economic preconditions shaping the future development of green hydrogen technology across Asia — part of *Future of Economy in Asia: Geopolitical Diplomacy, Technological Revolutions and Sustainable Pathways* (Springer Nature).
